name: monet
description: Engineering workflow skills for Claude Code that draft commits and PRs, review code, shape prose, visualize findings, and run a fleet of agents through a plan.

branch_prefix.title: Branch prefix
branch_prefix.description: Text put in front of each branch name that monet creates, so a branch is <prefix><slug> (for example, the prefix me/ gives me/fix-login). Leave it empty for no prefix.

data_dir.title: Data directory
data_dir.description: Directory where monet keeps your own data, such as voice personas. monet never writes inside the plugin directory.
